title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 2+1+2+ PARKING POST NEAR WILLSON SQUARE!
description_en: We offer for sale an apartment of typology 2+1+2+ parking post. The apartment is located in a very sought-after area on Margarita Tutulani Street, near Wilson Square, Kosovareve Street, the artificial lake. With a wide range of facilities around such as financial services, schools, institutions and in the city center near bars, restaurants and lively life in the area of ​​the block only 3 minutes away. The apartment is located on the first floor of an existing building, with a net area of ​​70 square meters. It is organized by a separate kitchen, which used to be a veranda but is closed and legalized, along with the living room, 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. It is offered partially furnished. A very good opportunity both for housing and for investment as there is a high demand for monthly or daily rent with the online booking / abnb platforms. It has regular mortgage documentation. For more information or a visit to the property, contact me.
